title: Five-Bull Sight-In
desc: General sight-in. Five 2.5 in. bulls on a 1 in. grid. Pistol 7-15 yd, rifle 25-50 yd.

title: 100-Yard Zero Grid
desc: 1 in. squares. At 100 yd each square is about 1 MOA (1.047 in.). Center diamond for zero, corners for confirmation.

title: 25 m Metric Zero
desc: 1 cm squares. At 25 m each square = 0.4 mil (about 1.4 MOA). Move impacts to the center circle.

title: MOA Dot Ladder
desc: Dot sizes in true MOA at 100 yd. Rows: 2, 1.5, 1 and 0.5 MOA. Shoot each row smaller as you tighten up.

title: Precision Bullseye
desc: Slow-fire scoring target. Rings 10 to 5 plus X ring. Score each shot by the highest ring it touches.

title: Rimfire 12-Bull
desc: Ten 1.5 in. record bulls plus two sighters. Built for 50 ft / 25 yd rimfire and air rifle practice.

title: Ten-Dot Drill
desc: 2 in. and 1 in. dots. Run each numbered string in order. Any miss on a string means you rerun it.

title: Reduced Silhouette
desc: Generic torso and head with scoring zones. Reduced size: shooting it at 10 yd looks like a full-size target at about 30 yd.

title: Shapes & Numbers
desc: Call-out drill. A partner calls a shape, a color, or a number and you engage only that target. Builds target ID under time.

title: Tic-Tac-Toe
desc: Two shooters, one target. Hit a square to claim it with your color of marker. First to three in a row wins.

title: Plate Rack
desc: Two racks of six 1 in. plates plus a stop plate. At 10 yd each plate matches a 4 in. steel plate at 40 yd.

title: Error Diagnosis
desc: For a right-handed handgun shooter (mirror it if left-handed). Fire 10 slow shots at the center, then read where they cluster.

title: Load Development
desc: Ten 1 in. diamonds for a ladder or OCW test. Write the charge and seating depth under each.

title: Transitions
desc: Three head boxes spread wide. Draw, one shot each left to right, then right to left. Push speed, keep hits in the box.

title: Half-Inch Grid
desc: Blank 1/2 in. grid with a center cross. Use it for anything: group measuring, custom drills, or a backer.

title: Range Log
desc: Record each group. Measure center-to-center (largest spread minus one bullet diameter).

title: Pocket DOPE Cards
desc: Four 3.5 x 4.25 in. cards. Cut on the dashed lines, fill in your come-ups, and tape one to the stock or keep it in a sleeve.

title: Full DOPE Sheet
desc: One rifle, 50 yd steps out to 1000. Record conditions at the top so you know what the data was shot in.

title: Angular Reference
desc: How big a MOA, a mil and one click are at each distance, plus range-estimation and conversion formulas.

title: Wind Card
desc: Wind value by clock direction, field cues for estimating speed, and a blank hold table for your load.

title: Round Count Log
desc: Track rounds, cleaning, parts and malfunctions for one firearm. Helps you replace springs and barrels on schedule.

title: Range Day Checklist
desc: Run through this before you leave the house. Laminate it and check boxes with a dry-erase marker.

title: 36-Yard Zero
desc: Grid squares are 1 MOA at 36 yd (0.377 in.). A common carbine zero distance. Confirm at your far distance afterward.

title: Data Book Page
desc: One page per string. Plot where you called each shot and where it hit. The gap between the two shows what to fix.

title: Metric DOPE Cards
desc: Four cut-out cards ranged in meters (100-1000 m) for mil-based optics. Same layout as the yard cards.

title: Range Card
desc: Sketch your sector from your position: left and right limits, reference points and their ranges. Fill in the table to match.

title: Range Estimation
desc: Mil-relation table in meters. Measure the target in mils through your reticle, find its row, and read the range.

title: Fundamentals Card
desc: Safety rules, the marksmanship fundamentals, position checkpoints and immediate action for a stoppage. Laminate for the range bag.

title: Dry-Fire Log
desc: Daily dry practice tracker. Unload, move all ammo out of the room, verify empty, and pick a safe backstop before every session.

title: FBI Q-Style
desc: Bottle-shaped 'Q' target used in law enforcement qualification. Any hit inside the bottle counts.

title: FBI QIT-Style
desc: Q bottle with the lower part cut off by a dashed line. Only hits inside the bottle and above the line count.

title: FBI Pistol Qual Card
desc: The publicly reported FBI pistol qualification: 60 rounds on a QIT-style target, 48 hits to pass. Score each stage below.

title: Police Silhouette
desc: B-27-style law enforcement silhouette with scoring rings 7 to 10 around center mass. Training replica.

title: Military E-Type
desc: Standard military head-and-torso silhouette (about 19.5 x 40 in. full size). Any hit on the silhouette counts.

title: Military F-Type
desc: Head-and-shoulders silhouette (about 19.5 x 23 in. full size), representing a target behind cover.

title: Scaled Distance Silhouettes
desc: E- and F-type silhouettes shrunk to simulate 100-300 m when shot from 10 m. Build distance skills on a short range.

title: Practical Competition
desc: USPSA/IPSC-style action shooting target with A, C and D zones and head box. Training replica.
